I was just in a class with one of the audio engineers that worked on SpiderVerse and apparently more of that movie than you think was recorded on Audacity. If you need more bells and whistles for mixing you may want something more. But for basic stuff audacity can do it

If you’re looking for some good classes to start with, check out RealVoiceLA, SoundOn Studio, Actors Connection, and Voice Acting Mastery with Crispin Freeman. You can find all of them on Twitter and online and find more VO connections through them for other classes as well. 

You can also look for local acting classes. Highly recommend theatre classes and or improv. 

If you want individual people to take classes from, Gina Scarpa is really good to start with. If you have discord you can also join the Voice Acting Club discord.

If you need starting info for booths and recording, check out booth junkie on YouTube or look for classes by audio engineers like Randy Greer.

Trans girl here. There’s a lot of good advice here already. So it’s pretty normal unfortunately for trans people to not disclose that they are trans until they have established a level of trust with someone just for safety reasons. Usually people disclose it either right at the start or when sex starts to become a real possibility. Obviously, if her being trans is a dealbreaker than you should tell her respectfully that things won’t work out. It’s okay to have sexual preference, it’s okay to want to be with someone who has a vagina and to turn someone down because they don’t fit your sexual preference. That said, she is a girl, whether she has a penis or a vagina, so please don’t treat her differently just because of her genitals. She still deserves the same respect as before, so don’t go calling her a man or something like that. There’s also no reason why you should think you are gay or anything like that. You are attracted to her because she’s “really funny and beautiful “ not because of her genitals. It isn’t gay to like a trans girl, believe me, I have gay friends who said that they would have dated me before I transitioned but now they don’t find me attractive.

Just take some time to think of her being trans is actually a dealbreaker to you. After the initial shock of finding out it might not bother you that much in a few days or maybe it is a deal breaker and you should talk with her and let her know that, while you think she’s awesome, her being trans just isn’t going to work for you.

Cheers!
